note2quiz_description: [Your App Name]: AI-Powered RAG Examination PlatformOverview[Your App Name] is an AI-powered online test application built on a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture. Designed to streamline the assessment process, the platform accepts syllabus notes and generates automated questions along with options. Registered students can take dynamic, session-based tests. The system then validates the results on the spot, providing an immediate, seamless feedback loop for learners.  🏗️ Architecture & Technologies UsedThe project is structured into dedicated components for the user interface, backend processing, and the AI/RAG pipeline.ComponentTechnology / ImplementationFrontendNext.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS (Modern, responsive UI for students and admins)BackendFastAPI (Python) for asynchronous API handling and document processingDatabasePostgreSQL for user/session data; OpenSearch for vector storage and retrievalAI & NLPLangChain / LlamaIndex (Orchestration), Embedding Models, LLM (for generation)InfrastructureDocker & Docker Compose for containerized deployment1. Frontend (User Interface)The frontend provides a clean, intuitive interface for two primary user flows: admins/teachers uploading materials, and students taking assessments.Upload Dashboard: Interface for instructors to upload syllabus copies and lecture notes.Assessment Portal: A secure, session-based testing environment for registered students.Real-time Feedback: UI components designed to display instant grading and result validation upon test submission.2. Backend (API & Data Management)The Python-based backend handles the heavy lifting of user management, session tracking, and orchestrating the AI pipeline.User & Session Management: Endpoints to authenticate registered students and assign them to specific testing sessions.Evaluation Engine: Business logic to instantly cross-reference student answers with the AI-generated correct options and validate results on the spot.3. AI & RAG Pipeline (The

)The core intelligence relies on a robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline integrated with OpenSearch.Document Ingestion: The system parses uploaded syllabus copies and notes, extracting raw text.Chunking & Embedding: The extracted text is intelligently chunked to maintain semantic context, converted into vector embeddings, and stored in OpenSearch.Dynamic Question Generation: During a test session, the system randomly selects topics from the OpenSearch database.Difficulty Scaling: The LLM generates contextually accurate multiple-choice questions related to the retrieved topics, scaling across different difficulty levels, and automatically identifying the correct answer among the generated options.⚙️ Core Application FlowMaterial Ingestion: An instructor uploads a syllabus or study notes into the system.RAG Processing: The backend parses the document, chunks the data, generates embeddings, and indexes them securely within OpenSearch.Session Initialization: A registered student logs in and initiates a specific testing session.Dynamic Assembly: The AI randomly retrieves topics from OpenSearch and dynamically generates a unique test, complete with varied difficulty levels, options, and hidden correct answers.Assessment & Validation: The student completes the multiple-choice test. Upon submission, the system instantly validates the choices against the generated answer key and provides immediate results.
